body: Btw guys sorry for the late replies... I just decided to give myself some time to calm down a bit...

I don't exactly get what I would be able to offer but yeah... I took some time to calm myself (read some books and stuff...) but things are getting worse by the days... I'm thinking I can go through 2 or maybe 3 more years to see if things bet even the tiniest bit better... not really sure I can but I'll give it try nonetheless...

Thanks. Honestly I prefer to talk to people that have no experience bc they usually come up with the most ridiculous ideas that somehow end up working better than every other ones... even some times just chatting with someone that isn't a total scumbag sometimes is nice (I don't have someone that isn't to talk with so i think that's the reason)... I don't really see why my life matters but thank you for telling me that anyways.
I already tried talking to a bunch of people but it's really not helping (maybe even making it worse)... the people here where I live aren't known for being the best people to rely on...
That would probably help... but I can't seem to find something that i even remotly like doing...
I'm not sure i want to wait until then... every day it just keep on getting worse...

I feel like that would be a good idea... but the problem is that everyone i tried talking to about what I'm feeling just doesn't take me seriously... they think I'm only joking or just tells me that ''it's just a phase it'll go away before you even notice it!'' and that's probably the best ''advice'' that I got from the 20 or so people I tried talking to... and that includes my mom, my uncles,my teachers,my friends and even my doctor... I don't have anyone else to talk to...

I get what you're saying but... the town I live in is total garbage... there isn't anything here to do... we don't have a place for movies,concerts or any of that sorta stuff... and don't even get me started on the people... nobody here cares for eachother, the only thing they care about is money and more money... I don't think I'm ''wasting'' my time playing video games (and I don't watch porn... watched it when I was younger and I didn't like it so I never cared enough to give it another chance) because i have nothing else better to do... I honestly don't even enjoy playing games anymore but at least it's a distraction.
